instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: InnovateFlow is a medium-sized B2B software company specializing in project management tools for the construction industry. They focus on optimizing workflow efficiency and resource allocation through cloud-based solutions.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company recently implemented a minor feature update based on internal user feedback to improve reporting speed. They have also experimented with integrating basic AI components into their project scheduling module, but these efforts remain small scale and exploratory.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is aggressive revenue growth through expanding market penetration in new geographic territories. The company aims to increase customer lifetime value by offering premium service tiers based on their established product stability.
answers.teamSize: The core development team consists of 15 engineers and a small dedicated marketing unit.
answers.additionalContext: Market competition is intense in the project management niche. The company relies heavily on maintaining technical excellence to justify premium pricing.

opportunities.title: Automated Customer Onboarding Workflow
opportunities.rationale: By streamlining the onboarding process with automated documentation and guided setup modules, we can reduce friction for new clients, leading to higher retention rates without major architectural changes. This is a low-risk way to improve customer experience.

first_actions: Pilot the workflow with 10 new trial users
resources_needed: Internal project management tool subscription (low cost)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce onboarding completion time by 30% within Q3.
milestones: Launch pilot program for new feature (Month 2)

opportunities.title: Tiered Feature Expansion Strategy
opportunities.rationale: Instead of a radical overhaul, we will focus on incremental growth by developing high-value add-ons for our existing user base. This leverages current technical capabilities and directly supports the goal of increasing customer lifetime value.

first_actions: Identify three most requested feature enhancements from NPS feedback
Create a phased roadmap linking features to premium pricing tiers
Run A/B testing on pricing structure changes for one tier
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average revenue per user (ARPU) by 10% in the premium tier.
milestones: Define feature roadmap for next 6 months (Month 2)

next_steps.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of current customer onboarding friction points and prioritize the most impactful incremental improvement.
Develop a lean project plan for the automated onboarding pilot and secure necessary internal resources.
Establish quarterly metrics tracking key growth indicators (e.g., churn reduction, ARPU) related to strategic goals.

key_weaknesses: Slow internal process for feature request prioritization leads to missed opportunities.
Talent scarcity in specialized cloud infrastructure engineering.
High reliance on manual data entry points, which increases operational risk.
